title: EU Russian natural gas imports, official source reconciliations

limitations: EU imports fell sharply but rose from 2023 to 2024; not a monotonic decline

Russian pipeline and LNG volumes must be separated before causal sanctions analysis
Different EU datasets may differ in coverage and revisions
